sentences.en: Those regulations all apply to everyone without a single exception.
sentences.zh: 这些规则对每个人都没有例外地适用。

sentences.en: I don't know how to legally get around those regulations.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如何合法绕过这些规定。

sentences.en: They plan to do away with most of these regulations.
sentences.zh: 他们计划废除大多数这类规定。
